items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: He later played with Jimmy Joyce, made all the recordings with Jimmy.

ctx.x: And Gilbert is one of my favorite clarinet players, always. I was crazy about him. I learned a lot from him just listening to him play with Ham because he was outstanding. He later played with Jimmy Joyce, made all the recordings with Jimmy. He didn't play many courses but he was the clarinet, the best clarinetist in Texas in my opinion.
Yeah. In fact, he sort of reminded me of rap if I remember correctly. That's possible.
